papers.headline: Near Resonance, Less Ordered: Radius and Mass Ordering in Compact Multi-planet Systems
papers.summary: Compact multi-planet systems exhibit a tendency for planetary radii to follow ordered sequences with orbital position, suggesting that these non-random patterns preserve a fossil record of their formation.
papers.title: Near Resonance, Less Ordered: Radius and Mass Ordering in Compact Multi-planet Systems
papers.authors: A. Heron, S. Wang, C. Petrovich

papers.headline: A Universal Ratio Linking Cosmic Expansion and the Growth of Structure
papers.summary: We identify a universal relation between the onset of cosmic acceleration (z_t) and the turnover (z_pk) of the linear growth observable fσ₈.
papers.title: A Universal Ratio Linking Cosmic Expansion and the Growth of Structure

papers.headline: oMEGACat-JWST I.: Project description and photometric data release
papers.summary: Omega Centauri (NGC 5139, ω Cen) is the most massive globular cluster in the Milky Way and the likely stripped nucleus of an accreted dwarf galaxy.
papers.title: oMEGACat-JWST I.: Project description and photometric data release
